title: Reverse statistics-target direction: lower default_statistics_target 300->150
configuration_cause: default_statistics_target=300 was raised from 100 across r005/r006/r009/r010/r013; the r013 300->500 step was refuted (GetUserTweets p50 +6.9%, p95 +5.7%, TPS -6.5%). The monotone-upward statistics direction is falsified, so the justified move is the opposite direction with equal-or-larger safe amplitude.
mechanism: GetUserTweets dominates 87.6% of terminal capacity at p50=138us with an Index Scan plan already observed. Raising statistics resolution to 300/500 did not shorten the index path and instead regressed TPS, consistent with ANALYZE/planning overhead and MCV bloat on a skewed user_id without selectivity benefit. Lowering default_statistics_target to 150 halves histogram/MCV build cost and planner estimate work while retaining 1.5x the original 100 resolution, testing whether the incumbent's high target is a net cost.
query_effect: GetUserTweets remains on its observed Index Scan path; planner estimate cost per call drops slightly, and ANALYZE cycles on the tweets/user tables complete faster, reducing background CPU contention with the 5 terminals.
expected_tps_effect: Increase successful_transaction_tps by >=0.3% relative to incumbent 32428.77 rps.
expected_latency_effect: Decrease GetUserTweets p50 and p95 by >=1% relative; no tail regression expected.

predictions.rationale: Lower statistics target reduces per-call planning/estimate overhead on the dominant transaction; reverses the refuted upward direction.
Same mechanism at the p95 leaf; r013 showed p95 rose 5.7% when target went up, so the reverse should recover.
Freed terminal capacity from shorter GetUserTweets raises completed-transaction goodput.

alternatives.statement: default_statistics_target is not on the critical path; GetUserTweets latency is bound by index page access, so 300->150 leaves p50/p95 and TPS unchanged within noise.
The real lever is planner cost calibration, not statistics resolution; a random_page_cost/seq_page_cost move would change the GetUserTweets path while statistics target stays inert.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent carries default_statistics_target=300, a value reached by a monotone-upward sequence whose final step (300->500) was refuted with -6.5% TPS. Reversing to 150 tests the untested downward direction with a larger safe amplitude than the refuted step, targeting the 87.6% terminal-capacity transaction without touching the already-observed Index Scan plan.

nodes.label: Reduced histogram/MCV build and planner estimate cost on skewed user_id

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Lower from incumbent 300 to 150, inside allowed [50,500]; 1.5x the original 100 resolution, a larger safe downward amplitude than the refuted 300->500 upward step.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: column statistics resolution for skewed user_id selectivity; lower target cuts histogram/MCV build and planner estimate cost

cross_domain_requirements: If statistics target is inert, memory_storage WAL commit-path and concurrency_maintenance predicate-lock bundles remain the competing mechanisms for the 87.6% terminal-capacity transaction.
